title: louis_annoyance__folklore
source_delivery: louis CK (fast build, wide pitch, flat deadpan)

beats.label: setup
beats.text: You know what annoys me about the fae? They make you pay for EVERYTHING. I left a saucer of milk for one of them, and the next morning there's a bill. A BILL. For milk.

beats.label: escalation
beats.text: And it's itemized. 'One saucer, whole milk, 2% preferred, not provided. Late fee: one firstborn. Interest compounds weekly.' I don't even have a firstborn! I'm 200 years old and I still live in a TREE.

beats.label: deadpan
beats.text: And the worst part? The milk was fine. It was good milk. Organic. I paid MORE than I owed. And they still sent me to collections. A fairy showed up at my door — tiny little guy, wing suit, clipboard — and he says, 'Sir, you owe us a firstborn or equivalent magical service.'

beats.label: closer
beats.text: I said, 'I don't HAVE a firstborn.' He said, 'Then we'll take the tree.' I've been sleeping in a bush for THREE WEEKS.
